clue.text: As a crossword is finished, well-informed

parts.note: a crossword has clues written for it, so it is clued
up means over or finished, as in time is up

explanation.surface: Finishing the crossword shows you are a person who knows things.
explanation.walkthrough: 'As a crossword is' describes a crossword furnished with clues, then 'finished' gives UP, as in 'time's up'.
explanation.definitionFit: An idiom for being knowledgeable or fully briefed on a subject.

clue.text: Sky put article in text of news story

indicators.note: put in signals one piece placed inside another

parts.note: journalists call the text of a story copy
an is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: A newspaper editor slips a word into a reporter's story about the sky.
explanation.definitionFit: Poetically, the sky is the vault or covering overhead, a sense of the word as an overhanging covering.

clue.text: UN secretary-general in truth anti-imperialist

indicators.note: in says the name sits inside the run of clue letters across truth and anti-imperialist

explanation.surface: A UN chief is described as truthfully opposed to empire.
explanation.definitionFit: The Burmese diplomat held the top United Nations post from 1961 to 1971.

clue.text: Those partial to chicken and chips in for unsightly fat!

parts.words: Those partial to chicken and chips
parts.note: the part shared by the starts of chicken and chips is CH, and there are two of them: a double CH

explanation.surface: Fans of chicken and chips eating in get fat round the jaw.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Those partial to' looks like fans of the food, but means the partial words: CH begins both chicken and chips, so two CHs make DOUBLE CH, followed by IN.
explanation.definitionFit: A fold of flesh under the jaw is a classic example of unwanted fat.

clue.text: Issue driven by these gambles, modest cut invested

indicators.note: invested means placed inside, as money goes into a venture, so the bets enclose the other pieces

parts.note: punts are bets
shy means modest
to pare is to cut

explanation.surface: Gamblers cut back their modest stakes while investing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Issue' means children, who are driven hard by these ambitious mothers and fathers.
explanation.definitionFit: Issue means offspring, and over-ambitious mothers and fathers push their children hard.

clue.text: See 4
Support figure going over testament, as advocate

indicators.note: in a down answer, a piece going over another sits above it

parts.note: a prop is a support
one is a figure, a number
NT is the New Testament

explanation.surface: A supporter goes through a will as a lawyer would.
explanation.definitionFit: Both nouns name a person who argues for a cause or proposal.

clue.text: Flower of Lancashire and Yorkshire neither red nor white?

definitions.text: Flower of Lancashire and Yorkshire neither red nor white?

parts.words: Flower of Lancashire and Yorkshire neither red nor white?
parts.note: Lancashire's emblem is a red flower and Yorkshire's a white one of the same kind; drop the colours and the plain flower is left

explanation.surface: A question about the floral emblems of two rival English counties.
explanation.walkthrough: Lancashire and Yorkshire are neighbouring counties in northern England, whose houses fought the Wars of the Roses.
explanation.definitionFit: Both counties take this bloom as their emblem, differing only in colour.

clue.text: One group breaking record that's nutty

indicators.note: breaking means splitting the other word open and getting inside it

parts.note: a note is a written record
I is the Roman numeral one
a set is a group

explanation.surface: A band smashes a record that is a little mad.
explanation.definitionFit: The word describes something flavoured with or tasting of hazelnuts.

clue.text: Secret society's opening, they carelessly having hidden key

indicators.note: opening means the first letter of society's
having hidden means the jumbled word holds the next piece inside it
carelessly means the letters of they are tossed about

parts.note: Alt is a key on a computer keyboard

explanation.surface: A secret society's launch is botched by members who hid a key.
explanation.walkthrough: 'carelessly' scrambles THEY to TEHY, which hides ALT: TE-ALT-HY.
explanation.definitionFit: Done in secret describes acting furtively, without being noticed.

clue.text: Asian leader, man in vessel from the East

indicators.note: in an across answer, reading from the east is reading right to left
in places one piece inside the other

parts.note: an urn is a vessel
he is a man

explanation.surface: An Asian leader arrives as a man aboard a vessel from the East.
explanation.walkthrough: In an across answer 'from the East' means reading right to left.
explanation.definitionFit: Jawaharlal of that surname was India's first prime minister.

clue.text: Ridge on course to lose a 21

indicators.note: on means one piece follows the other in an across answer
to lose means the letter a is dropped from the racecourse

parts.note: Ascot is a famous English racecourse
a spine is a ridge, as of hills

explanation.surface: A hilltop overlooking a golf or race course loses its tree.
explanation.walkthrough: 21 is TREE. Ascot is a racecourse in Berkshire, England.
explanation.definitionFit: This conifer native to Caledonian forests is a species of the plant named at 21.

clue.text: Prisoner at first notably distressed to be incarcerated in old area of punishment?

indicators.note: at first takes the first letter of Prisoner
incarcerated means locked inside, so the jumbled word goes within the next piece

parts.note: ex means old or former

indicators.note: distressed means the letters of notably are shaken up

explanation.surface: A distressed prisoner is locked up in an old punishment area.
explanation.walkthrough: 'distressed' scrambles NOTABLY; the question mark flags that the definition is a sporting sin bin rather than a jail.
explanation.definitionFit: In ice hockey and similar sports, the sin bin where penalised players sit out is a zone of punishment.

clue.text: Pat on the back far from rare?

definitions.meaning: an exclamation of praise, congratulating someone
of steak, cooked right through, the opposite of rare

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is both a congratulation and the description of thoroughly cooked meat.

clue.text: Ear to brain, extraordinary lapse

indicators.note: extraordinary means out of the ordinary order, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A strange lapse occurs between the ear and the brain.
explanation.definitionFit: A temporary departure from normal behaviour or thinking is a slip.

clue.text: See 17
Draw in game set to change

indicators.note: to change says the letters of in game set are rearranged

explanation.surface: A tennis set is about to swing in someone's favour.
explanation.definitionFit: To attract strongly, as a lodestone pulls iron, is to draw in.

clue.text: Vegetarian diet under microscope, initially

indicators.note: in a down answer, a piece under another comes after it
initially takes the first letter of microscope

parts.note: to diet is to eat less

explanation.surface: A vegetarian's diet is studied closely under the microscope.
explanation.definitionFit: Food with no flesh in it suits those who avoid animal products.

clue.text: Actor extracting copper from a lot of salad ingredients served with ham and hollandaise sauce?

parts.words: served with ham and hollandaise sauce
parts.note: eggs of this kind come on a muffin with ham and hollandaise

indicators.note: extracting means taking the named element out

parts.note: a batch of cucumbers is a lot of salad vegetables
Cu is the chemical symbol for copper

explanation.surface: A recipe: remove the copper, then serve salad with ham and hollandaise.
explanation.walkthrough: The egg dish named eggs Benedict supplies the first name.
explanation.definitionFit: The English star of Sherlock is a famous film and stage performer.

clue.text: Planet clearly illuminated using iron and lead

parts.note: using an iron is smoothing or evening out cloth
the lead in a show is its star

explanation.surface: An instruction for illuminating a planet with iron and lead, like alchemy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'using iron' is the verb even plus -ing, smoothing out creases.
explanation.definitionFit: Venus shines brightly in the western sky after sunset.

clue.text: Capital quiet, after endless cheers on Japanese borders

indicators.note: after means the quiet letter follows the shortened toast
on in a down answer puts the last piece beneath
endless drops the final letter of the toast

parts.note: skol is a Scandinavian toast, like cheers
p is the musical marking for quiet

indicators.note: borders are the outer letters of Japanese

explanation.surface: A capital falls quiet after endless cheering at the Japanese border.
explanation.definitionFit: This city is the seat of government of North Macedonia.

clue.text: Unlikely to fill empty seats in part of the theatre

indicators.note: to fill means going inside the emptied word
empty leaves only the outside letters of seats

parts.note: tall, as in a tall story, means unlikely

explanation.surface: A show is unlikely to sell out, leaving the seats empty.
explanation.definitionFit: The ground-floor seating in front of the stage in a British theatre is a section of the house.

clue.text: Plane perhaps hijacked by buccaneer, turning back

indicators.note: back says the hidden letters are read backwards
hijacked by says the word is seized and held inside the following clue words

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A pirate seizes an aircraft and turns it back.
explanation.walkthrough: The draft put 'hijacked' in the definition; it signals the letters held inside 'buccaneer, turning', so the definition is just 'Plane perhaps'.
explanation.definitionFit: The plane is a common broad-leaved shade species, an example given with perhaps.

clue.text: Misery, western and Aliens — nothing between them

indicators.note: between them puts the next piece inside the pair of aliens

parts.note: two aliens are two ETs, the film alien
a blank is nothing

explanation.surface: A dull film night pairs a western with Aliens, nothing in between.
explanation.definitionFit: A misery is a killjoy who dampens everyone's fun.

clue.text: Cow, like her mate?

definitions.meaning: a cow's mate is a bull, so like her mate is bull-ish

explanation.definitionFit: As a verb it means to intimidate; as a whimsical adjective it means resembling a male bovine.

clue.text: See 12
Article inaccurate I alter, do I?

indicators.note: inaccurate means the letters of I alter do I are put wrongly in order

explanation.surface: A writer worries whether altering an inaccurate article is their job.
explanation.definitionFit: A leader in a newspaper is an opinion piece written by the paper's staff.

clue.text: Drive crooked mile around Peterhead

indicators.note: around means the jumbled letters surround the next piece
crooked means the letters of mile are bent out of order

parts.note: the head of Peter is its first letter, P

explanation.surface: A winding mile-long drive near the Scottish port of Peterhead.
explanation.walkthrough: Peterhead is a fishing town in north-east Scotland; read as Peter-head it gives P.
explanation.definitionFit: To urge or force forward is to propel or push.

clue.text: First two of seven different punches — that will teach you!

indicators.note: punches means pushes into, so one piece goes inside the other
first two of takes the opening pair of letters of seven

parts.note: other means different

explanation.surface: Seven punches of different kinds teach someone a lesson.
explanation.definitionFit: A triumphant retort said after proving a point or getting one's way.

clue.text: Look for New York to contain a countering team from that city?

indicators.note: countering means running counter, so everything is read backwards

parts.note: to seek is to look

indicators.note: to contain means holding the letter inside

parts.note: NY is New York

explanation.surface: Search New York for a rival team from that city.
explanation.definitionFit: The New York baseball club is the city's famous sports team.
